The tenant has sent the January solar meter photo, so I've emailed the reading to the landlord and put the case on hold until the next quarterly reading.

**Where the case stands:** This is a recurring admin task, not a repair: the landlord wants a photo of the solar meter reading from the tenant every 3 months. We emailed the tenant for the photo on 11 Jan and again on 17 Jan. The tenant (signed "Miles Fletcher") replied at 02:42 on 17 Jan with an email that only contained a signature. I've taken the attached photo as his reply: it shows the meter reading **16845**, with the solar system's emergency switch ON. The property, tenancy and repair-history lookups only repeated what the case file says; there's no other history and no landlord instructions.

**What I did:**
1. **Emailed the landlord** (message MSG-F817D8, delivered). The text was:
   > Address: Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ
   > Hi,
   > Please find attached the latest photo of the solar panel (PV generation) meter reading, which the tenant sent us on 17 January 2025.
   > Reading: 16845 (Single Phase Watt Meter, 1000 imp/kWh, Juniper Utilities)
   > Date of photo received: 17/01/2025
   > Note: the solar PV emergency isolator is shown in the ON position, and we saw nothing in the photo that needs attention.
   > We will ask the tenant for the next quarterly reading in mid-April 2025. If you would like readings on a different schedule (our file also mentions mid-June), please let us know.
   > Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings
   > [Attachment: solar PV meter photo]
2. **Added an internal note** (NOTE-BFE2B6) with the points below.
3. **Set the status to waiting for the tenant** (STS-1CCB5A): "Jan reading (16845) received and sent to LL 17/01. Hold for next quarterly reading. Mon 14 Apr 2025: email T for meter photo; if no reply by Thu 17 Apr, chase by SMS + email."

**Points to check:**
- **When the next reading is due:** the original request (Nov 2024) and the holds since then say "mid June", but we asked for a reading in January and the task is every 3 months. I've gone with mid-April and asked the landlord to confirm in the email.
- **Possible logging error:** the 13 Jan call is logged as made to the tenant but mentions a "caller from Oakfield Compliance". Nothing to act on.
- **Tenant name missing:** the name Miles Fletcher isn't in the tenancy record yet, so it should be added. I didn't pass his phone number to the landlord because they didn't need it.

No ticket, contractor, spend or escalation was needed.

**Next steps:**
- **14 Apr 2025:** email the tenant for the next meter photo.
- **17 Apr:** if there's no reply, chase by SMS and email.
- **About 22 Apr:** if there's still no reply, note it and tell the landlord.
- **Whenever the photo arrives:** send it to the landlord.
- **If the landlord replies saying mid-June:** move the hold date.

**Alternative next action:** a short thank-you email to the tenant confirming we got the photo.

**Follow-up:** check again Mon 14 Apr 2025 and email the tenant for the next quarterly reading.
